scripts.backend:wait: sh -c "until curl -sf http://localhost:3002/api/openapi.json > /dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 0.5; done"
scripts.dev: sh -c 'bun run start:postgres && bun run kill && bun run dev:backend & BACK_PID=$!; bun run backend:wait; bun run dev:web; kill $BACK_PID 2>/dev/null || true'
scripts.build: sh -c 'bun run dev:backend & BACK_PID=$!; bun run backend:wait; bun run --filter backend build; bun run --filter web build; kill $BACK_PID 2>/dev/null || true'
scripts.kill: sh -c 'pids="$(lsof -t -i:3002) $(lsof -t -i:3000)"; if [ -n "$pids" ]; then kill $pids 2>/dev/null || true; fi'
